  • Class
    Description
    EagerStoreStrategy
    StoreStrategy that maintains a complete subject/predicate/object index over the triple set at all times.
    IndexedSetTripleStore
    TripleStore that stores all triples in a single TripleSet and delegates pattern-matching to a configurable StoreStrategy.
    IndexedTripleSource
    Minimal view onto an indexed-by-int triple collection, used by the shared iteration primitives (IndexListIterator, IndexListSpliterator, IndexListsIterator, IndexListsSpliterator) so they can resolve integer triple indices back to Triple instances without coupling to a single concrete type.
    IndexList
    Append-only list of int triple indices, used by the eager indexing strategy as the value type of the per-node index lists ("for the subject node N, here are the indices of all triples whose subject is N").
    IndexListIterator
    Iterator that resolves the integer indices stored in an IndexList back to Triple instances by looking them up in a IndexedTripleSource.
    IndexListsIterator
    Iterator over the intersection of two IndexLists, used by the eager indexing strategy to answer two-key patterns (e.g. subject-and-predicate or predicate-and-object).
    IndexListSpliterator
    Spliterator counterpart to IndexListIterator: walks an IndexList in ascending order and dereferences each integer index against a IndexedTripleSource to yield triples.
    IndexListsSpliterator
    Spliterator counterpart to IndexListsIterator: walks the intersection of two IndexLists, dereferencing each surviving triple index against a IndexedTripleSource.
    NodesToIndices
    FastHashMap from Node to IndexList, used by the eager indexing strategy as one of the three subject/predicate/object indices ("for this node, here are the indices of all triples that mention it in the corresponding slot").
    TripleSet
    FastHashSet of Triples used as the canonical triple collection inside IndexedSetTripleStore.
